requirements.label: Project script runs end-to-end (not assessable from report text alone — check attachments)
Project network has at least 100 nodes
Project report fills at least 5 pages
Testable, dataset-specific scientific question (not opinion or generic slogan)
Report includes how the network was operationalized (node, edge, weight, source)
Results state key numbers frequently in prose — not only in tables/figures
Figures and tables are cited by number and explained in text (not just shown)
Analysis is concrete and readable — not vague buzzwords without evidence
Report has a "what this tells me, and what it doesn't" close
GitHub URL pasted in Canvas text (optional if code submitted as attachment only)
No AI-written prose in the report — wording is mine
